mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by CYP450 enzymes (febuxostat by CYP1A2, 2C8, 2C9; modafinil by CYP3A4, CYP2C19) with potential for modafinil to induce CYP3A4 and inhibit CYP2C19, potentially reducing febuxostat levels.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels and gout control; adjust febuxostat dose if needed; no absolute contraindication but requires clinical vigilance.
